verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's docs describe an autonomous Work mode that carries a larger task through to a reviewable result (docs-28). In that mode it can search the web, browse websites, compare sources and summarize findings (docs-90), and it can draft reports and turn research into documents (docs-66, docs-68). Web search shows citations in the chat (docs-86). However, no dedicated deep-research run is documented, and nothing ties these pieces together into a many-source, cited report. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented deep-research mode, evidence that citations carry into the generated report, the depth and breadth of autonomous source coverage, and independent hands-on corroboration of research runs.
